sources.title: Model System | kaylorchen/rk3588-yolo-demo | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The model system in the RK3588 YOLO demo provides a comprehensive framework for deploying state-of-the-art object detection models on embedded hardware. By supporting both YOLOv8 and YOLOv10 in various task-specific variants and sizes, the system offers flexibility for different use cases and performance requirements.

sources.snippet: Model Conversion Relevant source files This page provides a detailed guide on converting YOLO models from PyTorch (.pt) format to ONNX and then to RKNN format for deployment on RK3588 platforms. The focus is on YOLOv8 and YOLOv10 models, with specific attention to the differences between RKNN toolkit versions that impact performance.
